verdict.rationale: PostHog docs explicitly list retention as a built-in insight type alongside trends, funnels, paths, stickiness, and lifecycle, and cohorts/person properties are documented as filters usable for slicing (e.g., feature flag rollout by cohort, group, or person property). Combined with dashboards/alerts for tracking over time, this covers the core story well. Missing for 10: no explicit example showing retention insight specifically filtered/sliced by a behavioral cohort, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of this exact workflow.
